paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bava Metzia 96b, raising an objection to Rava.[^1]

notes.text: The supplied notice names Bava Metzia 96b and says that the subject raised an objection to Rava. The stored Davidson scalar names Rav Chilkiyah son of Rav Avya as the questioner; its recipient is implicit in that scalar. Rava as recipient is preserved from Hyman's explicit notice, without importing the legal discussion.
